<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Raging Resistance](/Classes.aspx?ID=2)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 82

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

Repeated exposure and toughened skin allow you to fend off harm. While raging, you gain resistance equal to 3 + your Constitution modifier to damage types based on your instinct.

See specific [instincts](Instincts.aspx) for more information.
name: Raging Resistance
